title: HIH - Business Project Lead Analyst
description:
**Role Title:** HIH - Business Project Lead Analyst
  
Position Overview
  
The Lead Analyst, Finance Process Optimization, will support the Finance Forward transformation program by developing, testing, and implementing proofs of concept and process improvement solutions identified through Finance process discovery activities.
  
Working closely with the Finance Process Optimization team, Finance SMEs, and technology partners, this role will transform process improvement opportunities into working prototypes and scalable solutions. The individual will leverage a broad technical toolkit including AI/GenAI, Python, automation platforms, analytics tools, and advanced Excel to drive efficiency, improve data quality, and reduce manual effort across Finance processes.
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on problem solver who enjoys building solutions, experimenting with new technologies, and rapidly translating business requirements into practical outcomes. Success in this role requires strong technical execution skills, curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for process improvement.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Solution Development Technical Execution
  
  

* Build and enhance proofs of concept, automations, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled tools for Finance process improvement opportunities.
* Utilize the most appropriate technologies, including AI/GenAI, Python, Alteryx, Power Platform, SQL, and advanced Excel, to solve business problems.
* Rapidly develop, test, and iterate prototypes based on business feedback and evolving requirements.
* Participate in evaluating emerging technologies and identifying opportunities to improve Finance operations.

Process Improvement Analysis
  
  

* Partner with process optimization teams and Finance SMEs to understand current-state processes, challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Analyze process flows, operational data, and business requirements to support solution development.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, automate, and improve existing Finance processes.
* Support current-state and future-state process design activities.

Testing, Validation Deployment Support
  
  

* Conduct testing and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.
* Measure and document expected benefits, efficiency gains, and operational improvements.
* Troubleshoot issues, refine solution logic, and incorporate user feedback.
* Support pilot deployments and early-stage adoption efforts.

Documentation Delivery Support
  
  

* Create technical documentation, process documentation, and solution design artifacts.
* Prepare solution requirements and handoff materials for engineering and delivery teams.
* Maintain organized documentation of prototypes, lessons learned, reusable components, and best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing within the team.

Required Skills Qualifications
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience developing automation, analytics, or technology-enabled process improvement solutions.
* Experience working with Python, SQL, Alteryx, Power Automate, Power Apps, advanced Excel, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/GenAI tools and the ability to apply them to solve business problems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured business data.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in business process improvement, automation, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to Finance processes such as Accounting, Financial Close, FPA, Reporting, Controllership, or Shared Services operations.
* Experience with AI/GenAI use cases, document intelligence, workflow automation, or data analytics solutions.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience using Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools.
* Experience supporting proof-of-concepts, pilots, and technology implementation projects.

About Evernorth Health Services
  
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Professional, PDS Projects
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
1. Position Summary
  
The Project Planning & Controls Lead is responsible for providing planning leadership, schedule governance, and delivery assurance for data center construction and infrastructure projects delivered under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) model.
  
Acting as the client’s planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. The position works closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to provide clear, data-driven insights that support timely decision-making and delivery certainty across one or multiple mission-critical data center projects.
  
2. Key Responsibilities
  
Planning & Controls Leadership
  
Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
Develop, maintain, and govern integrated master schedules and detailed project programs in alignment with PMC and client standards.
  
Establish planning principles, schedule structures, coding, and reporting frameworks across the project portfolio.
  
Act as the central authority for schedule integrity, logic, and baseline management.
  
Schedule Development & Governance
  
Review, validate, and integrate contractor and consultant schedules into a coordinated master program.
  
Ensure alignment of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities across all workstreams.
  
Define and manage key milestones, critical paths, and interface dependencies.
  
Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects.
  
Progress Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting
  
Implement consistent progress measurement methodologies across all disciplines and contractors.
  
Track progress against baselines, identify variances, and provide forward-looking forecasts.
  
Prepare high-quality schedule reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for client and project leadership.
  
Highlight risks to milestones and critical paths, with clear mitigation and recovery options.
  
Risk, Change & Recovery Planning
  
Support identification of schedule-related risks and development of mitigation strategies.
  
Perform schedule impact assessments for changes, delays, and scope adjustments.
  
Support recovery planning, acceleration strategies, and what-if scenario analysis.
  
Contribute to risk registers and delivery assurance reviews from a planning perspective.
  
Delay Analysis, Claims Review & Forensic Support
  
Perform schedule delay analysis using appropriate methodologies (e.g., impacted as-planned, time impact analysis, as-built vs. as-planned).
  
Review contractor delay notifications, extension of time (EOT) submissions, and time-related claims from a planning and technical perspective.
  
Independently assess the validity of delay causes, critical path impacts, and entitlement implications (schedule-focused, non-commercial).
  
Support the client and Project Director with objective, data-driven advice related to delay responsibility and mitigation options.
  
Maintain robust schedule records and contemporaneous updates to support defensible delay assessments.
  
Contractor & Consultant Coordination
  
Coordinate closely with contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary consultants.
  
Challenge and validate contractor progress updates, logic, sequencing, and forecasts.
  
Facilitate planning workshops, look-ahead sessions, and interface coordination meetings.
  
Promote consistent planning standards and a collaborative, transparent approach to schedule management.
  
3. Technical Expertise (Data Center Focus)
  
Experience working in mission-critical and data center delivery environments.
  
Strong understanding of data center construction sequencing and phased handover strategies.
  
Knowledge of commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and readiness-for-operations sequencing.
  
Familiarity with redundancy-driven sequencing, concurrent builds, and live environment constraints.
  
Ability to interpret technical inputs from electrical, mechanical, ICT, and specialist systems into integrated schedules.
  
4. Tools & Methodologies
  
Advanced proficiency in planning and controls tools such as Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
  
Experience with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or equivalent).
  
Working knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, or equivalent project controls methodologies.
  
Understanding of schedule risk analysis, critical path management, and planning best practices.
  
Strong data management and reporting governance capability.
  
5. Qualifications & Experience
  
Education
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  
Experience
  
15-20 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls.
  
Direct experience supporting data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  
Proven experience managing integrated schedules across complex, multi-contractor environments.
  
Professional Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)
  
PMP, PMI-SP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management or planning certification.
  
Primavera P6 professional certification is an advantage.
  
6. Core Competencies
  
Strong coordination and contractor interface management skills.
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability.
  
Clear, concise communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  
Ability to translate complex schedule data into actionable insights.
  
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-risk, mission-critical delivery environments.
  
Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Staff Program Manager, FinOps and Procurement Operations
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As a Staff Program Manager in Product Operations, you will run the financial operations that keep Teradata's product organization licensed, funded, and accountable for spend. You will own day-to-day execution across software purchasing, cloud FinOps, cross-charges, and budget tracking, and you will run the controls and reporting that leaders use to make spend decisions. Based in India, you will work closely with global Product, Engineering, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders.

* **Software purchasing and PO operations:** Own the end-to-end purchasing cycle for product software, tooling, and services, from usage analysis and vendor quotes through requisitions in Oracle Fusion, approval routing, contract signature, PO issuance, receipting, and invoice resolution.
* **Renewals and licensing:** Maintain the product software license and renewal register, surface renewals well before term end, and work with Procurement and system owners to confirm options, terms, and required license quantities.
* **FinOps and cloud-spend execution:** Track R&D cloud spend against budget across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, prepare recurring spend reporting, validate cloud provider invoices and marketplace offers, and coordinate savings plan and commitment purchases while monitoring realized savings.
* **Cloud cost optimization:** Coordinate cost optimization workstreams, including account decommissioning and transfers, tagging and cost allocation, and follow-through with product and engineering owners on savings actions.
* **Cross-charge and budget tracking:** Track cloud, tooling, and software budgets and outlooks, validate and reconcile monthly cross-charges and chargebacks between departments, and reconcile monthly against Finance records with clear variance explanations.
* **Planning cycles:** Support annual budgeting and quarterly outlooks by working with budget owners and Finance on spend assumptions, license requirements, and forecast changes.
* **Operational controls:** Run controls over purchasing and spend, including approval hierarchy checks, complete cost center and GL coding, confirmation of delivery before receipting, and audit-ready records.
* **Reporting and follow-through:** Produce recurring reports and dashboards for Product Operations and product leadership, and drive open actions, missing data, and blockers to closure.
* **AI and automation:** Apply foundational AI skills to automate routine reporting, reconciliation, and follow-up, and identify manual steps that should be simplified or retired rather than automated.

**Who You’ll Work With**

You will work as part of Teradata's Product Operations team, collaborating daily with:

* Finance partners on budgets, outlooks, cross-charges, and monthly reconciliation.
* Procurement on supplier engagement, contract renewals, purchase orders, and invoice resolution.
* Product and Engineering leaders, budget owners, and system owners on spend ownership, license requirements, and cost optimization actions.
* Cloud FinOps and cloud operations teams on spend data, tagging, cost allocation, and savings initiatives.
* Software vendors, resellers, and cloud service providers on quotes, order forms, and billing.
* US-based Product Operations leadership during a regular daily overlap with US business hours.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 6+ years in procurement operations, software asset management, FinOps, or financial operations, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud, or technology companies.

Strong data management and reporting governance capability.

Education

Experience
  
15-20 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls.
  
  
Direct experience supporting data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects.

Primavera P6 professional certification is an advantage.

Site Engineer must ensure safe, correct, and timely **installation of DG sets, panels, fuel system, exhaust system, earthing, and cabling** as per approved drawings, standards, and safety norms. **Data Centre experience is preferred**.

* Material Handling \& Equipment Installation – Inspect and verify receipt/storage of DG sets, heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, piping, valves, and accessories; carry out proper installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, and mounting of DG sets and associated equipment as per approved drawings.

* Pre\-Commissioning \& Testing Activities – Perform leak tests, hydrotests, insulation tests, alignment and rotation checks, verify oil/coolant/fuel/battery conditions, confirm relay settings, alarms, interlocks, and sensor feedback systems before commissioning.
